assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: single square original fantasy ARPG support-gem icon for a parchment and leather spellbook UI. Paint a warm amber circular lens gem held in a weathered old brass openwork setting with four gently unfurling leaf-shaped wings, visually suggesting magic spreading into a wider area. Centered, bold clear silhouette readable at 58px. Rich but restrained hand-painted gouache/oil texture, tangible metal and faceted amber, small cream highlights. Background deep warm burgundy-brown worn leather. Match traditional illustrated medieval grimoire art, not a vector diagram. No words, letters, numbers, borders, captions, logos or watermark. No modern technology, circuitry, gears, neon or cyan glow. No character or weapon. Make a polished square game inventory illustration with generous outer margin, one object only.
